text:
nina_sales: FYI - Apollo demo tomorrow AM escalated to their CTO. They want three things cleared before the exec demo: 1) SSO for console access, 2) written answers to their updated security questionnaire, and 3) a short reserved capacity window to guarantee p95 < 150ms for 256-token generation under bursts. Need an internal short plan + one-paragraph exec note by EOD.

oleg_se: Can someone paste the exact p95 traces they're seeing? I want to try a repro from our side (private-relay) first.

maya_cs: CTO shared a sanitized run: `POST /v1/generate 200 256 tokens p95=420ms tail=920ms` from a VM inside their VPC hitting our relay. They explicitly called out tail spikes during burst traffic.

devin_eng: Two likely suspects: connection churn from ephemeral client VMs + low batching due to short inter-arrival times. Short-term mitigation: spin a 12-hour Dedicated window in their VPC with `min_replicas=2`, enable connection pooling at the relay, and set `batch_window_ms=20` for canary. That combo usually drops p95 a lot.

prudence_legal: Before we give console or SSO we need a signed addendum (minimal) and SSO access scope locked to a demo-only service account. I'll draft the addendum and share for e-sign by 6pm.

nina_sales: Great. @oleg_se can you run the repro and confirm p95 numbers if we apply batch_window_ms=20? Also we may need to offer a short commercial concession (credit) for the reserved window — head_of_sales wants a recommended ask.

oleg_se: I'll kick off a quick load from their ip-ranges via infra-bot: 
```
infra-bot: run-sim --target apollo-demo --qps 10 --burst 20 --duration 300 --path /v1/generate
```
Leaving the auth redacted. I'll attach the trace link when done.

infra-bot: Simulation started  run id `sim-3150000000-01`.

devin_eng: In our lab I reproduced with the same profile. Baseline p95 420ms -> after `batch_window_ms=20` + connection pooling -> p95 ~140-160ms. Adding NVMe cache for KV reduced p95 to ~125ms. Canary looks promising.

maya_cs: CTO also asked whether we can guarantee zero egress to internet during the demo and whether they can bring their own KMS for encryption of model artifacts.

prudence_legal: We can support BYO-KMS under Private deployment with a DMZ cutover; needs an ops security checklist and legal addendum. No public egress can be enforced by strict route tables and NAT disabled. I'll coordinate with @devin_eng to confirm ops feasibility.

nina_sales: Cost question: what is the delta for a 12-hour reserved window (2xA10g equiv) vs a short hosted burst? Head_of_sales needs a figure to decide on discount.

devin_eng: Quick thumb: reserved 12h with NVMe + private relay + ops premium ~ $1,800. Hosted burst equivalent with no reservation ~ $600 (but can't meet guarantees). If we offer a POC credit (say 30%) net becomes ~$1,260.

oleg_se: Trace uploaded: https://redwood-internal/trace/3150000000  sanitized. After canary config p95 ~150ms, tails much reduced.

maya_cs: I've started populating the security questionnaire answers (apollo_security_v2_answers.docx). Outstanding items: BYO-KMS confirmation text and NVMe persistence retention window.

prudence_legal: For BYO-KMS I'll provide the approved language and required indemnities. NVMe persistence: we need to state retention=ephemeral (demo-only) and manual wipe after window. That should satisfy their compliance team.

nina_sales: Action items (I'll compile into a one-paragraph exec note): @devin_eng validate NVMe + batch settings in our canary and share numbers; @oleg_se attach full repro trace and monitors; @prudence_legal draft addendum + approved BYO-KMS wording; @maya_cs finish sec questionnaire answers.

infra-bot: Canary deployment scheduled  id `canary-3150000000-01`. Monitoring hooks enabled.

devin_eng: Confirming canary ran: p95=148ms, p99=220ms, tail max=300ms during a 5-min spike. NVMe lowered p95 to 132ms in the same run. Logs attached to the trace.

prudence_legal: Draft addendum uploaded: https://redwood-legal/apollo/addendum-demo.pdf  includes BYO-KMS clause and access scope limits. Please review.

maya_cs: Questionnaire answers uploaded to shared drive and linked in the customer packet. Also added the demo runbook steps to enforce no-egress.

nina_sales: I'll send the exec note to Head of Sales and CTO of Apollo after we confirm numbers. Meeting invite for the demo remains set for tomorrow 09:30 PT. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

oleg_se: After exec sign-off we'll do a controlled rollout and keep verbose metrics for the demo window. I'll shadow the dashboard.

infra-bot: Ticket INF-3150000000  status updated to "ready-for-exec".
